mapper.select: SELECT idx AS "idx", sys_id AS "sysId", upr_cte_idx AS "uprCteIdx", cte_nm AS "cteNm", cte_expl AS "cteExpl", sort_ord AS "sortOrd", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM TN_PRD_CTE_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND del_yn = 'N' AND upr_cte_idx = #{uprCteIdx} AND upr_cte_idx IS NULL ORDER BY sort_ord ASC, idx ASC
